# Clément Balanger — Clemiche Labs

> Freelance Flutter tech lead based in Paris, France. Updates, secures and
> moves forward Flutter apps that nobody has time to take over. Fixed-price,
> asynchronous missions, one at a time, for businesses only. French and
> English.

## Who

- Developer since 2019; mobile tech lead at a Paris startup since 2024.
- Co-founder of Diseed (2021–2024), a social app for sharing anecdotes in
  French and Brazilian Portuguese, with LLM features in production
  (content categorisation, translation, image generation).
- Builder of Migrea (migraine tracking app, open beta, Flutter + Supabase)
  and LineUpVote (festival group voting).
- Stack: Flutter, Dart, Node.js, TypeScript, Firebase, Supabase,
  PostgreSQL, CI/CD, Claude Code.

## Offers (fixed price, EUR, VAT not applicable)

- Flutter store update: 1,200 € per app (up to 25 dependencies), 2 weeks.
  Target Android 16 (API 36) for Google Play, build with Xcode 26, move
  from CocoaPods to Swift Package Manager, dependencies updated, test
  builds submitted. Agencies: 3 apps for 3,000 €.
- Production-readiness audit: 1,500 €, 2 weeks. Architecture,
  performance, security, tests, CI, store release, costed recovery plan.
- Supabase or Firebase hardening: 890 €, 2 weeks. Configuration review
  (RLS, Firestore and Storage rules, auth, keys), fixes in your repo, then
  re-check. Not a penetration test. Written authorisation required.
- AI feature: 900 € scoping, then integration from 5,000 €.
- Also: white-label Flutter subcontracting for agencies; technical
  assessment of Flutter candidates, 250 € per candidate.
